Plan, procure, and manage Carbon Credits, Energy Attribute Certificates (EACs), and Sustainable Aviation Fuel Certificates (SAFc) from a single, centralized platform.

Learn more

Hear from our customers

Tiana Trumpa
Climate & Net Zero Lead
at Deutsche Telekom

At Deutsche Telekom, we are proud to have found a trusted partner in CEEZER, who shares our philosophy and provides access to high-integrity decarbonization projects. As a global corporate committed to setting an example in the fight against climate change, we have set ambitious climate targets, and with CEEZER’s support, we’re moving closer to achieving them.

Ursula Finsterwald 
Head Group Sustainability
at LGT

We work with CEEZER every quarter through an ongoing partnership. They're constantly monitoring the voluntary carbon market alongside us to identify the best projects that match our specific criteria, keeping us informed of the latest developments and helping optimize our carbon credit portfolio. When it makes sense, they help us secure supply over longer timeframes, and their dedicated in-depth risk assessments on individual projects give us the confidence we need.

Sophia Wieland
Sustainability & Climate
Change Lead at Celonis

Our climate contribution strategy aims to advance meaningful climate action that drives real innovation in the carbon removal space. The partnership with CEEZER enables us to access high-quality projects that align with our data-driven approach to sustainability.

Alexander Cox
Head of
Climate Markets

Climate Performance Assets (like EACs) are an important complement to internal decarbonization within a holistic climate strategy, though market fragmentation and poor data quality pose significant challenges. CEEZER's platform provides the independent transparency and risk data which are essential for effective and compliant engagement with these complex markets.” 

Maria Venus
Senior Sustainability Environmental
Manager at Fenix Outdoor

CEEZER's expert guidance, platform, and reporting help us make sense of the carbon market each year. Their structured approach, clear guidance, and CSRD-compliant overview of the carbon credits ensures the final portfolio fits both our high quality standards and budget. I’ve found the mix of personalized assistance throughout the process and user-friendly tools really simplifies a complex topic for us.

Achieve net zero
‍faster, with certainty.

At CEEZER, we don’t just advise—our expert team acts alongside you, leveraging our enterprise-grade platform to build and manage your carbon credit portfolio.

From strategy to scale, we help you cut through complexity and deliver real climate impact. Our job is not done when you invest in the carbon market—it’s when you see measurable impact.

The CEEZER difference.

Dedicated climate expertise

Our in-house climate experts provide bespoke support—from carbon strategy and portfolio design to risk assessment, legal compliance, and more. Together, we build and manage your carbon credit portfolio tailored to your net-zero targets.

Unparalleled market access

Our team supports you in leveraging a transparent view on 10,000+ global carbon projects, including 200+ vetted and secured projects, with real-time pricing and volume data. This ensures tailored supply at the best prices now and in the future. 

Comprehensive portfolio management

Manage procurement, tracking, retirements, reporting, and distribution in one enterprise platform. Collaborate with subsidiaries, suppliers, and buyers to coordinate climate action—streamlined with our procurement technology.

Industry-leading risk assessment

Our proprietary risk assessment, Prism, screens across 400 validated data points per project and is built upon deep, data-driven due diligence conducted by our world-class climate team across all leading project types.

Audit-ready impact reporting

We help translate your climate assets approach into compelling narratives for internal and external stakeholders. Export consolidated certificates and portfolio data pre-formatted across all major voluntary and compliance reporting frameworks—ready for audits and revisions. 

Let’s unlock climate action—together.
